perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.desc: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.desc: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.desc:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Winterized Gear
perks.desc: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.

notes: [YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Draw Time / Reload] "Biting Winds rolls with some great perk combinations, like Rapid Hit/Explosive Head, Killing Wind/Swashbuckler, and even some utility picks like Sympathetic Arsenal. In general, for PvE you likely want to pin down an Explosive Head roll, Elastic String (Polymer or Flexible as 2nd choice), and just invest into getting Draw Time and Reload as far down as you can. It's infinitely more farmable than the (slightly better) Accrued Redemption, if you don't mind having to re-fight Kridis three thousand times." tags:pve
